name: obs_auth_allowlist_failure_count
description: Failed or unavailable hourly protected phone allowlist verification; aggregate status only, no extracted labels.
filter: resource.type="global" AND logName="projects/__PROJECT_ID__/logs/obs-auth-health" AND jsonPayload.message="auth.test_allowlist.health" AND (jsonPayload.status="failed" OR jsonPayload.status="unavailable")
